newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-MIM says Mt Isa output improving.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-MIM says Mt Isa output improving.

text.p: MIM Holdings Ltd said on Thursday that production had continued to improve during the 1996/97 financial year at its giant Mt Isa base metals mines in northern Queensland.
"Since the end of the 1995/96 year, production has continued to improve in all areas at Mount Isa, and this trend is encouraging," chairman Bruce Vaughan told the annual meeting.
"Coal production was satisfactory and profitable," Vaughan said. He said production continued to improve at the base metals McArthur River mine in the Northern Territory.
He said gold output also improved at the Ravenswood Nolan's mine in north Queensland.
"In Europe, lead and silver refining and zinc smelting operations performed well," he said.
Vaughan said good progress was made in the construction of the new copper-gold projects at Ernest Henry in northern Queensland and Alumbrera in Argentina.
In 1995, the Mount Isa mine was hit by six months of industrial action that severely disrupted production from the mine.
At 11.50 a.m. (0050 GMT), MIM shares were four cents up at A$1.64.
